name: AniNite
blurb: Austria's largest anime and manga convention, held at Austria Center Vienna with cosplay contests including a World Cosplay Summit heat.
notes: Homepage still only shows the Aug 7-9, 2026 dates ('Oeffnungszeiten 07.08.2026 - 09.08.2026') that already ran, with no next date announced yet, so editions is empty and that show is recorded as 'last'. Organizer confirmed on-site in the privacy text: 'Wir, AniManga Austria - Arbeitskreis japanische Jugendkultur (Vereinssitz: Oesterreich)...'. Cover uses the site's 'Banner_2026_FL.jpg' hero image (the most recent official banner) rather than og:image, which is an older 'Banner_2025_v1.jpg'.
